table_name: Carbonate System Equations, Constants, and Software
description: Equilibrium constants and formulations used to compute the ocean carbonate system. All chemistry columns in the dataset are deterministic outputs of these equations, not sampled values.

components.formulation: function of temperature and salinity, total pH scale
numerical d(ln pCO2) / d(ln DIC) at constant total alkalinity
solves for full carbonate speciation given any two of {TA, DIC, pH, pCO2}
independent bisection solver for [H+] built from the equations above, used for quality control
components.source: built for this project; validated against PyCO2SYS and published check values

known_constraint: Lueker et al. (2000) constants are calibrated for approximately 2-35 degrees C and salinity 19-43 psu. Polar draws below 2 degrees C represent a mild extrapolation; this will be stated explicitly and tested with an alternative constant set (e.g., Millero 2010) as a sensitivity case.
validation_reference: Solver outputs are checked against the published reference values in Dickson, Sabine & Christian (2007), Guide to Best Practices for Ocean CO2 Measurements.
